title: feat: add 12-hour delay to community model price and visibility changes
author: davealan74
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #13800

## Summary

- Delays price, paid-balance, and private-to-public changes by 12 hours
- Keeps the current public terms active until the deadline
- Exposes the pending terms and effective time to owners and model consumers
- Applies only the queued pricing fields, preserving newer credentials, fallbacks, and RPM settings
- Keeps first-time pricing and public-to-private changes immediate
- Adds the generated D1 migration and focused Enter/Gen coverage

## Verification

- Enter price-delay integration: 10/10
- Gen community registry integration: passed
- Enter and Gen typechecks: passed
- Biome and whitespace checks: passed

gist.headline: Terms, With a Landing Pad
gist.blurb: Community model terms now get a 12-hour settling period before a public price or visibility change takes flight. Everyone can see the next bloom coming, while the current one keeps doing its job.
gist.summary: Community model price, paid-balance, and private-to-public updates now queue for 12 hours while exposing pending terms and their effective time to owners and consumers; first-time pricing and public-to-private changes remain immediate.
gist.impact: Model consumers keep the current public terms for 12 hours and can inspect what is changing and when, while unrelated newer credentials, fallbacks, and RPM settings remain intact.
gist.visual_concept: A community-model garden has a clearly labeled current-price flower in bloom beside a smaller bud marked as pending, with a friendly 12-hour sand timer between them. Polli acts as the observant gardener, tending the still-active flower while a CRT monitor robot displays the upcoming terms and effective time; this represents transparent, gradual public-term changes rather than abrupt switches.
